description: The OpenProposal `LineItemSummary` profile: the fields of the `LineItem` document that the specification lists for it.

addressable_scale.description: What the line item can reach, recomputed against the buyer's selection. Not segment size. See below

audiences.description: The line item's `audiences`, projected to `available[].id` and `available[].name`.

break_position.description: The line item's `break_position`, projected to `available[].id`, `available[].delay`, and `available[].slotinpod`.

channel.description: Core terms in § 5.1.1. The discriminator for how the rest of the line item is read

commitment_bounds.description: The envelope inside which a buyer may commit, and a buyer MAY request another. See 5.6.1

committed_metrics.description: `CommittedMetric` tuples (§ 5.7.1). Seller declares its offered `level`. A buyer MAY request a stricter `level`, one further in `direction`. A request MUST NOT change a tuple's `direction`

delivery_counting.description: The line item's `delivery_counting`, projected to `impression_multiplier.impression_type` and `impression_multiplier.source_type`.

episodes.description: `new` | `catalog` | `all`. `new`: released within the flight. `catalog`: released before it. `all`: either

geo.description: Where the line item runs. `allowed[]` of `GeoCode` (below). A line item MUST NOT declare both `geo` and `markets`

markets.description: For a line item priced by market. See `GeoCode` below

placement.description: The line item's `placement`, projected to `reward`, `instl`, `plcmt`, `skip`, and `feed`.

pricing.description: The line item's `pricing[]`, each entry projected to `pricing_id`, `cost_method`, `list_rate`, `currency`, `price_type`, and `unit_bounds`.

programs.description: The line item's `programs`, projected to `available[].id` and `available[].content`.

properties.description: The line item's `properties`, projected to `available[].id`, `available[].name`, `available[].domains[]`, `available[].apps[].store`, `available[].apps[].bundle`, `available[].child_audience`, `available[].seller_relationship`, and `available[].venue_type`.

required_credentials.description: What a buyer holds to be eligible

title: LineItemSummary
